_comment: Voice-actor changes per NPC name (as shown in the client) + language (plan game-voice-reference §2.5, §11.4: the epoch matching the player's story progress is used). boundaryPatches = first clip token of the NEW voice, 5 digits XXYZZ (06100 = 6.1, 06006 = 6.0 part 6 — NOT 06010). Only confirmed changes with a checked token; research and open cases: docs/research/game-voice-actor-splits-de.md. Central copy is loaded from main (RemoteUrls.gameVoiceActorSplitsUrl); local override: <pluginConfigDir>/game_voice_actor_splits.json.
